label: At GO, rises with belief S1 is good; very low on first trial and after a2 S1 unrewarded.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u")
terms: (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial == 0)
explanation: Candidate unit 42 is saturated by phase (about -0.98 at D1/D2, +0.87 at GO); beyond timing, nearly all variance is at GO. There it grows with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good (an a1-leaning, model-based signal), is strongly suppressed (about -0.84) on the first trial of the episode, and is extra-low after a2 -> S1 unrewarded (rare unrewarded, which a model-based agent follows by staying with a2). The free fit adds other last-trial patterns at GO (a1 S2 r lower) and a small D2 belief term (0.63 vs 0.58 dev). Residual misses: long runs of unrewarded trials late in the episode push GO well below prediction and D1 above it, which the short form does not capture.

issues: The recorded short form reproduces: test R^2 beyond timing 0.561, with weights belief_lo +0.015, first trial -0.84, a2 S1 u -0.087. Every term is needed. belief_lo alone scores 0.35 and ep_trial==0 alone 0.14. The first two together score 0.49, so a2 S1 u adds about 0.07.

The a2 S1 u effect is specific to that pattern. Its GO residual is -0.134, while a2 S1 r is +0.017. Swapping it for broader versions does worse: a2-unrewarded scores 0.497, a one-trial S1-evidence term ((prev_state==S1)==(prev_reward==1)) 0.495-0.501, and a two-loss run 0.510. The other belief shapes did no better: raw belief 0.483, tanh(belief_lo) 0.541, clipped belief_lo 0.562. That last one is a tie, so the recorded form stands.

The largest remaining systematic error is runs of unrewarded trials late in the episode (t63-93). The worst-fit windows show actual GO values of 0.10-0.38 where 0.75 is predicted, and D1 values well above prediction. These windows are large but rare. A loss-run term recovers only part of it and does not fit within the 3-term limit (0.51 when it replaces a2 S1 u). The explanation already discloses this gap.
Smaller leftover errors at GO by previous trial: a1 S2 r -0.064, a1 S1 u -0.043, a2 S2 u +0.032. The free fit picks these up (0.607 vs ceiling 0.64), but they are modest.
The label matches the short form, but a reader cannot tell from it that the unit is pinned at about -0.98 at D1/D2 and that all of this structure is at GO.
